reviews.x: I got these for everyday purposes, and they look great ^.^ They're soft and look realistic if you use bobby pins to flatten and widen them a bit. The downfall is that the clip doesn't hold it in place very well, but this is easily fixed with like two bobby pins for each ear. Hope this helps :)

These are too cute. They are not massive. They are soft.  I struggled with the clip at first, but it takes a bit of practice and feeling out to perfect it lol. They do wiggle a bit on your head, but other than that, they are fine ^^  Fun to clip to elementary schoolers 😂 adorable  Lol i'm being silly in this pic

The ears are very silky/soft; I like the feel. The clips on the ears really aren't good enough to support the weight and a different style would have been preferable. I finally used them today and to remedy the problem, hold the clip in your hair in place and use two bobby pins per ear, outside of the ear toward the center, like a v. The drawback is they are really difficult to put into place. Even more difficult is getting the shape to match up with the opposite ear. This is really noticeable for me since I bought these ears along with their other style that has bells, but those have great shaping and don't need adjusting. reviews.t: Exactly what I was looking for!
reviews.x: I had purchased 3 different ears from Amazon for my Silver Fox costume. These were the most appropriate size and the most comfortable to wear. I ended up using the headband method and it stayed put all day, plus the headband is so thin it was easily  hidden by hair. Using the free style clip method was more difficult to install but I easily customized each ear with clips I bought from WalMart and positioned the clips to be at a better angle to clip more hair. I would highly recommend these ears.

reviews.t: so I would definitely recommend using some bobby pins to hold them in a ...
reviews.x: These ears are precious!!! The fur is so soft and they do look realistic. The clips are kinda weird, so I would definitely recommend using some bobby pins to hold them in a perky positon. They look great with layered hair. It gives it a definite Anima look!

reviews.t: They are adorable and suit her perfectly
reviews.x: Bought these for my girlfriend. They are adorable and suit her perfectly. They're little clips and the fur is very soft, the insides of the ink are black as well.
Super adorable and easy to clip on. I love them. And they are super soft!!!
It's hard to keep the ears in the right place but it's worth it.

These are wonderful cosplay cat ears. They're soft and almost look like real cat ears. These took forever to ship, however. I ordered my ears on the 28th of December and I got these on the 4th of January. Which is last minute considering I have a conversation this weekend.

reviews.t: Very satisfied! These ears are so soft and easy to ...
reviews.x: Very satisfied! These ears are so soft and easy to clip in. My only complaint is that they want to fold flat. So I use Bobby pins on either side of the clip to help flatten them. But you can't beat the price. I would definitely purchase again!

Cute, and cheap. These are clip-on cat ears, like barrettes. I have another pair that I like better that are fuzzier. These are soft, and plush. They work better with pigtails than when your hair is down, as it is easier to secure them.

reviews.t: Good value, clips don't stay put.
reviews.x: These constantly fall out of my hair and the ears feel like they don't sit right. This being said, the fabric is soft and they don't look cartoon-y. for the price you are not going to find better.

reviews.t: So big and fluffy! They are connected to large ...
reviews.x: So big and fluffy! They are connected to large barrettes that are black and will hold you hair in place but if you are a blonde you can pull them off and use another color (not included).
so kawaii! im now a cute lil kitty cat! :3

reviews.t: Great but should probably come with instructions
reviews.x: This comes with a simple black headband, but it's a little unclear how to attach the ears to it.  You actually want to loop the headband through the fabric under the barrette clip, NOT clip the barrettes directly onto the headband.  If you do this right, the ears fit tightly onto the headband and sit great.  Otherwise they tend to flop all over and the headband is basically useless.  This is probably obvious to a lot of people, but given how many reviews there are about the ears being unstable,

Feel and look great, but a true black. I wanted it to match my hair but my hair is a shade or two lighter. Also, I have a fro and one side tries to eat the hair, and the other is rebelling tough. I think it would be easier if the clips went against the grain instead of with it.  The headband it came with is great. reviews.t: These are adorable!! I get so many compliments when I ...
reviews.x: These are adorable!! I get so many compliments when I wear them!! I wear them a bunch too! They are perfect for kitten play, and they are people size appropriate. They are easy to put in, however you have to play with them a little to get them in the right spot. Also you need a couple bobby pins to hold them in place. I made an x on both side where I wanted to put them and the attached them to that with a couple Bobby pins to secure. so I love them!!

reviews.t: I am so happy with these
reviews.x: I am so happy with these.  I purchased them for my wife and she would wear them 24/7 if she could.  They attach by two painted metal clips that can be removed if you want to attach the ears some other way.  We tried attaching them to her motorcycle helmet but they were too flimsy in the wind.  She wants them in every color now.

These cat/wolf/animal ears are perfect! They don't look cheap like other ears and are completely furry. They are a perfect size, too. So, so, cute. Once you clip them on as well, they are not going anywhere. I would secure them with bobby pins though, just in case you are walking around with them all day or if it's windy.

These ears are great. They’re soft & the clip has a good hold so I’m not scared of them falling off. I gave them 4 stars because I received two right ears instead of one right & one left. The back of them is wider than the front so it is noticeable that one is backwards but they work for what I need them for.

These ears are Amazing!  They stay in place without the use of a headband.  Each ear has its own barrett so you can clip them onto your hair however you like.  Plus, they are very comfortable.  If you are looking for a pair of kitty ears these are the ones to buy.  They get two thumbs up!

reviews.t: I like but could b better
reviews.x: Likes: very soft. Very dark rich black color. Looks like fur. Doesnt shed much.  Dislikes: alot smaller than picture. No contrast: would have been nicer 2 have a lighter tone n the center of the ear with the darker exterior. When u take a picture u almost wonder "wat is that"?

claims.text: Customers frequently describe the ears as soft and realistic-looking.
Many reviewers find the clips weak or awkward, saying the ears don't stay in place well.
Several customers recommend using bobby pins to hold the ears in position.
Reviewers often mention the ears are hard to shape or keep pointed and even.
Customers consider the product good value for the price.
